an6.77:1.1: 77 cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikātuṃ
an6.77:1.3: muṭṭhasaccaṃ asampajaññaṃ indriyesu aguttadvārataṃ bhojane amattaññutaṃ kuhanaṃ lapanaṃ
an6.77:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an6.77:2.1: cha bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ sacchikātuṃ
